en: I know I have made mistakes.
The wrong choices I made--
I thought the blood in my veins somehow made them right.
Words will not let me take any of it back. But I want to atone through action. I want to give my life for my people!
How delightfully amusing.
You man-creatures choose to live free of the other races?
Unwise... but no matter.
We shall soon see what value， if any， you humans possess.
You are concerned for your people. I understand.
Very well. The Earthblood will trouble you no longer.
Just remember: you are not alone in this world. One day， like it or not， you will have to join the greater conflict.
Yes， you seem ready.
It is time you learned of the workings of the world.
We dwell in， essentially， a laboratory--where a supreme Creator is testing us.
He seeks the ultimate warrior， one he can claim for himself.
The Skyborn are his servants; we， the Earthblood， are the warrior candidates whom the Creator rejected.
But humans--what are you? You too must have some role， some destiny. Would you like to know what that is?
The answers lie just ahead!
THE MASTER'S PLANS MUST BE EXECUTED AT ALL COSTS. YOU CANNOT STOP ME， HUMANS.
YOUR EMOTIONS PREVENT YOU FROM MAKING LOGICAL CHOICES.
You cowardly scoundrel! Release Princess Lucia!
Lucia!
What do you want with her!?
Hey! I thought you were tough! What kind of tough guy hides behind an innocent hostage!?
You craven abomination! You are no warrior if you use an innocent woman as a shield!
Wow! A damsel in distress! Wanna trade places?
Strike him down!
I am not afraid to die. I stood by and let Kanon terrorize our people with his kingdom of magic!
Now I must atone.
Ha! Hollow hunks of metal! I will take care of things here.
Your concern is with these “Earthblood“ and “Skyborn，“ whatever they are. Now go!
You man-creatures have turned on both of the higher races?
Unwise， but no matter. We shall soon see what value， if any， you humans possess.
YOU SEE? I HAVE WON. COME， PRINCESS. YOU ARE A VALUABLE ASSET.
Lucia is innocent! Does her life mean nothing to you?
I will never forgive this!
I can understand your hatred for a monarchy that deceives and tramples your people.
But you need to consider Kanon's reasons--the source of his own hatred.
All of our sorrow and pain can be traced to those Skyborn fiends who stare down at us coldly from the heavens.
You have grown strong， humans. You are ready.
It is time you learned of  the workings of the world.
We dwell in， essentially， a laboratory--where a supreme Creator is testing us. He seeks the ultimate warrior， one he can claim for himself.
But humans--what are you? Your role， your destiny is not yet set in stone. Fight now， and you could yet break free.
The world could be rewrought!
King Valgar is a demon? How could I not have seen it?
If what we just heard is true， we must face these Skyborn!
King Valgar is a demon? That's nuts!
But it sounds like we need to have a word with the Skyborn.
Are you seeing this， guys? King Valgar is a demon!
Hmm， seems like the Skyborn are who we're really after.
Do my eyes deceive me? The king is a demon!
This Earthblood seems to wish us no harm. Perhaps the Skyborn truly are to blame!
So， the king's a demon? Okay.
Let's just roll with that and go see these Skyborn!
Welcome， warriors. You were wise to come here in search of truth.
It it time you learned of the workings of the world.
I rule over the Earthblood， one of three races.
But humans--what are you? Your role， your destiny is not clear to me. Do you have the courage to go find out?
The choice is yours.
As you wish， then.
The black wizard's plans remain in motion. Perhaps you can still stop his mechanical creations from seizing power.
Very well! I will open the way to the heavens for you.
Go now， and learn the truth of what you humans are!
I misjudged you. And now， here we stand， left with but one way to resolve this.
We no longer need you man- creatures to shelter us while we nurse ourselves back to full strength. We are ready to destroy the Skyborn!
But you， foolish ones， shall be the first to incur my wrath!
Now that you are archenemies of the Earthblood， I will say only this--
The tyrant must be pleased. Today， you rid him of his greatest threat， and also ended his search. Fools...
I commend you， white warriors， on behalf of our Lord. You have surpassed even his greatest expectations.
There is another we owe thanks. Come forward， ye dead warrior. You have performed admirably as our messenger. Sleep， now， and be troubled no more.
We Skyborn hope your valiant actions serve as an example. Yours was a strong and noble race before you succumbed to the darker side of magic.
We were wrong to give you such a dangerous power， and will meddle with your world no more.
What skill! We never dreamed you had so much potential.
You no longer need guidance.
Had we known you humans had such bloodlust... You will make such powerful servants of our Lord!
What? Reservations about joining us on high? Nonsense. You have earned a place there.
And seeing as you are our finest champions， our Lord will quite insist you take it.
Ha ha ha! What vicious little darlings you are!
You are like itches in the small of my back: maddeningly unpleasant， except for that last moment of bliss--when you finally get SCRATCHED!
Aloha， chumps! Welcome to this story's dramatic finale!
All I have to do is mangle you twerps， and I'll be a national hero! Lord Zur does what the Black Ordoesn't!
Ouch! Okay， okay.
I admit it， I'm a loser. Why don't we just team up?
We could kill Valgar and be kings! Sweet deal， am I right?
That's it. We need to settle this， once and for all.
Valgar! Thank goodness!
Get those wimps!
I'd do it myself， but I， uh， I left my spine in the car! Better go get it!
Zur， you gutless vampire. All you know how to do is claw your way up people's backs in your quest for power.
The world has no use for you.
Begone!
HahahahahahahahaHAHAHAHAHA!
Vampire? Tsk， tsk， TSK.
What's wrong with digging in your claws now and then?
You call that bloodsucking.
I call it NOT SUCKING!
But thank you， Valgar!
The magic power you gave me--
makes me feel like a NEW MAN!
I'm bursting at the BRAINS--
I'm an inedible HULK--
and you're about to learn--
how SUPER Lord Zur really is!
Behold! A new hero... is

I just gotta ask: what kind of cosmic disaster causes people like that to exist?
At least we can take comfort in knowing his dark， er， reign has come to an end. The impostors are no more and the kingdom is safe!
Hmm...
Do you ever wonder if we went about this the wrong way?
We made an enemy of Valgar， but I realize now that even he acted out of a sort of love. He had the kingdom's best interest in mind.
Poor guy.
He didn't do things the smart way， but maybe you're right. He was just trying to reach out to his subjects.
Well， um， then that means...
Valgar's legacy is us. We have to carry on for him.
Yes， you're right.
He was bad at showing it，
but I believe that all Valgar wanted was an age of peace.
Yet we took so many lives. Did we truly act in the best interests of the land?
Good point. Kanon and his regime killed people， but...
What's our body count now?
Han! Geez! You can't think of it like that!
We're the good guys! Why else would the resistance and everybody else side with us?
I hope you are right， Randy.
Too many people died for us to squander this victory.
Let us swear here and now that tomorrow will bring peace.
I applaud your courage， man-creatures.
But vengeance upon the Skyborn belongs to US.
Do not interfere!
Humans， you have grown strong. Perhaps you were meant to slay the Skyborn， not us Earthblood.
But humans--what are you? Your role， your destiny is not yet set in stone. Fight now， and you could yet break free! You may， in fact， free us all.
I know I can never win your respect. But I love my kingdom all the same. Let me fight at your side!
Valgar?
Then protect Princess Lucia!
We'll stop that iron menace!
Works for me!
Get Lucia out of here.
I've got some metal to crunch.
Valgar!?
Fine. You handle things here. I'm going after Silver!
That gussied-up garbage can  is getting on my nerves!
The black knight... Very well. May you be stronger as ally than adversary!
Keep your sister safe.
Whoa. Really!?
That's so sweet! Watch your sister then， 'kay?
THE MASTER'S PLANS MUST BE EXECUTED AT ALL COSTS.
THEREFORE， I WILL EXPLOIT THE WEAKNESS OF THE HUMAN HEART.
You craven scoundrel! Let Princess Lucia go!
Lucia! Have you lost your mind?
She's your princess!
What? I thought you were tough! Tough guys don't hide behind hostages!
Princess! Grr， the metal apple  never falls far from the tree.
Wow! A damsel in distress! Boys are gonna be falling all over her! (If she lives...)
I am not afraid to die.
I stood by and let Kanon terrorize our people with his kingdom of magic!
How it must sadden our Lord that you， his Chosen， have walked this sorrowful path.
Explain yourself.
Somebody chose us?
Who!?
Um， Chosen?
You must have the wrong guys.
Chosen?
Don't be absurd. We choose for ourselves.
Chosen? Really?
Cool! What do I win?
Do you really believe these events that befell you were an accident?
That through your own skill you found that sword， and its wielder's resting place?
Ha ha! That you are so mighty you can level armies and dethrone great rulers?
No. All of this was wrought by the powers we concealed in the sword--a divine calling.
You were part of our plan. We chose you from among the scraps of humanity to be the lucky few we would craft into our ultimate warriors.
The golden one who led you here was our messenger.
But our Lord sorely misjudged you， and our messenger has betrayed us. Not one of you is worthy of his grace.
In his name， I shall scatter you all to the wind!
Alas， I chose unwisely.
As my ultimate warriors， you were to be my greatest creation.
But no matter. I scoured the scraps of humanity， and found another diamond in the rough.
The despair in his heart once threatened to break him， but he has found hope in power. By walking the path I set before him， he has been saved.
Come forth， my white warrior! Smite these infidels， and that disloyal pile of bones at their side!
Impossible!
Valgar， a champion of light?
Valgar? Didn't see that coming.
Um... what?
So， revealing Valgar's past has led him to an even more uncertain future.
Why him!? I was cooperating! Mostly... Okay， not really.
It shouldn't be like this.
But I was miserable! I had nothing left!
When he offered me power， It gave me something to cling to--a new identity.
That is right. You are special. My chosen!
Now do exactly as I say. Our adversaries stand before us. Strike them down!
No! You will not command me!
How is this any different from before?
The world is better off without you. No more gods and monsters--and no more puppets!
Valgar， no! What are you--
Hold it! What are you doing!?
Wait. Valgar， don't!
Stop! You mustn't!
Hey， no， don't!
Our Lord is wroth that his Chosen have taken so long to arrive at their destiny.
Chosen? What do you mean?
Chosen? What are you talking about?
Chosen? For what?
We choose for ourselves， as all men must.
I'm a Chosen? Well， you didn't TELL ME!
You are part of our plan. We chose you from among the scraps of humanity as the lucky few we would craft into our ultimate warriors.
The golden one who led you here is our messenger.
Now， fight me! Show our Lord the fruits of his labor!
Hear ye， warriors!
I have judged you worthy.
Now， come into my presence.
Ha ha ha! Is this the finest humanity can produce? We were cruel to say any of you could become the ultimate warrior.
HE STANDS BEFORE YOU!
Guys， are we， like， getting kidnapped?
That's not funny. I want to go home!
Brave warrior who died to keep my family safe， I ask you: is this what you wanted? Did you really return to us because you served some higher power?
I do not know your face or even your name. But I wanted to believe you served us， the people.  That you were our friend.
Wh-What treachery is this! You dare strike your Lord!?
You have no heart， no friends. You cannot be doing this!
Oh， he's doing it.
Some things just matter more than divine calling.
We fought because we love our country. Not for you!
This is madness! I have honored you by making you my sword and shield!
You gained that power under my guidance!
Paradise is already yours. You need only follow me!
We will not. You have misjudged us!
We choose to be free! To decide our own destiny!
You see this as defiance?
We see it as duty. If we follow you， the world below will be left in shambles.
We refuse to accept paradise and condemn others to ruin!
Fools! I made the world below!
It will stay forever in shambles， unless I right it!
That's your concern no longer!
ANALYSIS HAS DETERMINED HUMANS CANNOT SURVIVE UNDER THEIR OWN REGIME.
NOW THAT THE MASTER IS GONE， THE CODIFICATION OF HUMANITY FALLS ON OUR SHOULDERS.
What has Kanon done?
We will never submit to your wicked administration. Never!
And now that my PATIENCE is gone， I'm gonna hit you. Hard!
What's that， tin face?
Sorry. I don't speak junk-ese!
Ah! A wordsmith. Then quail， you querulous quack， while I quickly deliver the quietus!
“Codification“? Why you!
Nobody turns Nicoley into a fish!
That should put an end to Kanon's dreadful ambitions. Thank you.
It's finally over.
Lucia， where is your brother?
That's right. You and the kingdom are safe.
Hey， where's your brother?
All in a day's work!
Hey， what ever happened to your brother?
May history never forget.
Is your brother with you?
You're welcome!
What happened to your brother?
Valgar left. He said a higher power still threatened the land， and that he must rise up against it.
But that is his fight.
Will you stay here and help me rebuild the kingdom? I will accept any punishment--
I only ask that you give the people the peace they deserve.
Of course. And Lucia... the age of punishment and vengeance has ended.
Stability will return to this kingdom when we， those who love it， work together.
Let this next age be one of peace， and wisdom.
We have such a long road ahead to peace.
I can only wonder: have we done right by the world? All this killing... How are we different from Kanon?
Perhaps we aren't. Not yet. Only the future can tell. We must honor those lives we had to take， by honoring the wishes of our countrymen who still remain.
Let this next age be for them.
Gwaaaaaar!
Mwaaaaaarg!
Yaaaaaarg!
Waaaaaaugh!
On the battlefield， crowns and titles mean nothing. The only real distinction is not dying， and you've distinctly failed at that.
Rise! Perhaps， someday， you may be worthy of knighthood. Just not today!
Let today's victory be the first step toward tomorrow's!
Thank you， friends. I could never have triumphed alone.
I'm sure glad I didn't use my good sword!
Picking fights with heroes? Not a good idea.
You know， you really-- what's the word--suck.
I sense we have a strong team.
Not bad for a little shepherd boy， huh?
Whew! That was close. I thought my staff was gonna break from juggling you like that!
Gee， you think we were too hard on them?
Don't make me throw my bunny at you!
Tell my opponent I want my throwing stars returned as soon as possible.
Another battle， another victory!
Today's wisdom: a prepared sandwich mustards great power!
My clan teaches that the brittle twig is first to snap.
I'd just like to take a moment to thank my staff.
You just lost to a girl with a happy face around her neck. How weak are you?
Service with a smile!
I guess I could stick around and heal the losers， but-- SHOPPING!
You can't hit what you can't catch!
That's not all we rabbits are good at!
See? Having a rabbit on your side IS good luck!
As you know， there are winners and there are losers. The winners know it. The losers feel it!
It doesn't always pay to fight fair.
This sword is thicker and manlier than my old one!
Now this right HERE is what I call a Sword of Legend!
Be honest， did I kill you with the sword or with my impossibly good looks?
You can plainly see why I am a boss character， and not some lowly thug.
What fool would brandish a sword at one who commands the very fires that made it?
You were wise to ally with me!
Ha ha! You will never be worthy， but at least have the dignity not to be worthless.
SCANNING... NO THREAT FOUND.
TARGET OBLITERATED.
TICK TOCK， I JUST CLEANED YOUR CLOCK.
HOSTILE ELEMENTS NEUTRALIZED.
Big shoulder pads rule!
The chicks love me.
I don't need any help.
That's right， ladies: I'm single!
Sorry， friend. Wrong place， wrong time!
I captain the Red Order... and I champion it!
I need more knights who fight like me.
Shameful. I would blame your leader， had I seen any leadership.
How did I work you? Let me count the ways.
I'm like time-- I can't be stopped!
I just LOVE it when they squirm.
Roses are red， violets are blue. Sugar is sweet... and I just a-salted you!
Admit it， you didn't expect me to win.
I want a raise， a new sword， more rations， and armor that doesn't smell like BO.
I stuck you with the pointy end!
I hope my boss was watching.
I'm just the cook!
Hi， Mom!
Okay， everyone， look cool!
Chalk one up for the good guys!
Kiss my coccyx.
Got spine?
Don't feel bad. It was a “marrow“ defeat.
So， who wants to crack the first “boned“ joke?
It's cool to be undead!
If it's any consolation， you get to be like me now.
I smell bad!
Is that all? Come on， live a little.
You'll never guess what I'm wearing under these robes.
I won all the spelling bees at elementally school.
Feckless fools!
Smells like smoke.
Stop it， you're un-killing me.
I can't actually talk. You're hearing things!
Ahem... “Gwaaaaaar!“
When I find my other arm， I'll really do some damage!
Gargoyles know they're cool!
That's nothing compared to what I'm gonna do to you when the screen turns black!
I'm a flying rock. Whatchu got?
Crap， my legs fell asleep.

Line up， ya rascals， and I'll bend you over my knee!
Respect yer elders， ya derned whipper-snappers!

Life is good if you're gooey.
Kids love me!
Hey， baby. Wanna e-Lope?

There is a fine line between bravery and stupidity--and I just choked you with it.
You have fallen... AND YOU WON'T GET UP!
Insolent fools! No one purges like the Purger!
Nobody believes me when I say I'm the good guy.
Defeating me will be a greater trial than you can imagine!
You DARE challenge me!?
With my divine power， victory was preordained!
Hideous! Is this how you lower-tier creatures fight?
If I ever lose， I won't be upset， because I'll be too busy looking good!
I'm the best， even though my stunt double did all the work!
Hurry up and make me the star of the sequel.
I know， I know， everyone wants my autograph.
I just came to bury the hatchet... in your head.
You are not fit to polish my axe!
Ha! You hit like my squire.
Justice has been done.
You can reach， but you will never touch the sky.
I have a name. You're just not worthy of knowing it.
I am the ultimate warrior. You were ultimately nothing.
One of me is worth 100 of you.
And I was just warming up.
The blessings of the earth belong to the strong alone!
What stupidity! Learn to respect power beyond your own!
There's a name for those who fight like you. I believe we call them... losers!
Is this some sort of joke?
Foolish mortal， you amuse me!
You are not fit to kiss the ground I rule over!
Oh dear... I've broken another one.
I could have beaten you with patches over both eyes!
What sort of embarrassing performance was that?
I was born to lead.
Save the swelled head for when you become a swell fighter.
YOU WILL NEVER CATCH ME， COPPER.
MY ORBS FLICKER FOR YOU.

You know， you really--what's the word--suck.

I toss a rag doll... just like I tossed you around.
